unresolved.reason: 'Why' asks why something happened. The store holds filed figures, which can show that a number changed but never why it changed; a cause is not a quantity

clarifications.question: Which profit margin do you mean? They can differ by twenty points or more on the same company.

options.label: Gross margin
options.description: Revenue minus the direct cost of producing it. Shows pricing power and production efficiency.

options.label: Operating margin
options.description: Profit after operating costs but before interest and tax. Shows whether the core business works.

options.label: Net profit margin
options.description: What is left after everything, including interest and tax. The conventional reading of a bare "profit margin".
